domain_name.description: The domain name for which DNS entries are being managed.

entries.description: A list of DNS record configurations to apply to the domain. Each item represents a DNS entry to add, update, or delete.

entries.items.description: Flat map describing a single DNS entry within the entries list. Note: In the schema definition, 'items' defines the structure of the list elements for documentation/validation purposes, but in the actual values, this is a list of maps. The fields below define the expected keys for each map in the list.

entries.name.description: Name of the DNS entry (e.g., 'www', '@', '_dmarc'). Corresponds to --entry-name.

entries.type.description: Type of the DNS entry (e.g., A, AAAA, CNAME, MX). Corresponds to --entry-type.

entries.content.description: Content of the DNS entry (e.g., IP address or target hostname). Corresponds to --entry-content.

entries.expire.description: Expire time of the DNS entry in seconds. Corresponds to --entry-expire.
